item.title: Ashley Lawrence credits West Virginia and Nikki Izzo-Brown for the mentality behind her decorated career
item.description: Ashley Lawrence has an Olympic gold medal, a Champions League final appearance, and over 150 international appearances for Canada. This week she went on a podcast and credited WVU for building the foundation for all of it. Lawrence sat down with the Voice in Sport podcast this week for a wide-ranging conversation about her career. […]

item.title: Raiders releasing former WVU quarterback Geno Smith ahead of 2026 NFL Draft, per report
item.description: The Las Vegas Raiders are releasing quarterback Geno Smith barring a trade before the new league year, according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter.
